newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Policeman shot dead in Albanian town of Vlore.
newsitem.headline: Policeman shot dead in Albanian town of Vlore.

text.p: An Albanian policeman was shot dead on Wednesday in the southern port town of Vlore, where three people died during clashes early this week, an Interior Ministry statement said.

It said the policeman was shot dead by automatic gunfire in front of his home in the Adriatic town, which was the scene of clashes between riot police and anti-government protesters on Monday and Tuesday.
The statement identified the policeman as Shezai Zani.
Reporters in Vlore said a car had sped through the town during the day with someone firing an automatic rifle from the window.
One anti-government demonstrator was shot dead and two others died of heart attacks this week during clashes in the port town. About 150 people were injured in the clashes.

Albania has been swept by demonstrations and clashes over the past month when several get-rich-quick investment schemes collapsed and irate investors in Europe's poorest state blamed the right-wing government.
